title: Sequoia National Park: Climbing the Giant Trees
grammar: Modal verbs of deduction: must, might, could, can't

questions.sentence: Kirby climbed the tree for 80 minutes. She _____ be very tired.
questions.explain: Must + base verb for a logical conclusion.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explain: Must be = I am sure she is tired.

questions.sentence: The tree is 310 feet tall. It _____ be taller than the Statue of Liberty.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: It must be taller than the Statue of Liberty.
It might be taller than the Statue of Liberty.
It can't be taller than the Statue of Liberty.
It mustn't be taller than the Statue of Liberty.

questions.sentence: Kirby is only 5'2. She _____ not reach the top without climbing.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: She can't reach the top without climbing.
She mustn't reach the top without climbing.
She mightn't reach the top without climbing.
She could reach the top without climbing.

questions.sentence: The scientists are studying the canopies. They _____ want to learn more about trees.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: They must want to learn more.
They mightn't want to learn more.
They can't want to learn more.
They mustn't want to learn more.

questions.sentence: Kirby spent 80 minutes climbing. She _____ be exhausted.
Some people think climbing a tree is crazy. It _____ be dangerous.

questions.correct: Kirby must be tired after 80 minutes of climbing.

the top layer of a forest
